how_p2_differs_from_p1: P1's matrix names individual works with arXiv identifiers and records whether each body was read. P2's table names parents, several of which are literature families rather than artifacts, and records no access state at all. So P2's gap is upstream of P1's: before a receipt can be blocked on missing ORION-side fields, a donor artifact has to exist to bind to.
